verdict.rationale: Global employment through an employer of record or owned-entity international payroll is a fair question for a payroll product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only US payroll: state taxes, federal/state/local compliance, W-2s, and 1099 contractor payments. Nothing mentions employing people in other countries, EOR services, or international payroll.
